preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 500 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(3 <= N <= 100000 for N in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For every test case, N is an integer between 3 and 100,000 inclusive.
The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all((line.strip() == '-1') or (len(line.split()) == N and set(map(int, line.split())) == set(range(1, N + 1))) for line, N in zip(output_lines, test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output line is either '-1' or a space-separated sequence of N integers forming a valid permutation of 1 to N.

postconditions.expression: all((line.strip() == '-1') or (all((int(line.split()[i]) ^ int(line.split()[i+1])) != int(line.split()[i+2]) for i in range(N - 2))) for line, N in zip(output_lines, test_cases))
postconditions.description: For any valid permutation output, the condition P[i] XOR P[i+1] != P[i+2] holds for all valid indices i.

postconditions.expression: all((line.strip() == '-1') == (N == 3) for line, N in zip(output_lines, test_cases))
postconditions.description: The output is '-1' if and only if N is 3, as no valid permutation exists for N=3, while valid permutations exist for N >= 4.
